review: 702.56b: skip reason was false (Djinn Illuminatus grants a second replicate instance); replaced the skip with scenario 702.56b-1.

scenarios.title: Replicate creates one copy per payment of the replicate cost

setup.notes: Pyromatics costs {1}{R} and has replicate {1}{R}: it deals 1 damage to any target. Centaur Courser is a 3/3.

decisions: A casts Pyromatics targeting Centaur Courser, paying the replicate cost twice: {1}{R} plus two times {1}{R}, tapping all six Mountains.
The replicate trigger puts a copy per payment on the stack; both copies keep the target Centaur Courser. All players pass; the stack resolves.

variants.label: paid_twice
variants.expected: Two copies are created. Pyromatics and its copies deal 3 damage in total to Centaur Courser, which dies.

variants.label: paid_once
variants.delta: The replicate cost is paid once; four Mountains are tapped.
variants.expected: One copy is created. Pyromatics and the copy deal 2 damage in total; Centaur Courser survives with 2 damage.

variants.label: not_paid
variants.delta: The replicate cost is not paid; two Mountains are tapped.
variants.expected: No replicate trigger fires and no copy is created. Pyromatics deals 1 damage; Centaur Courser survives with 1 damage.

scenarios.title: Each replicate instance copies the spell for its own payments

setup.notes: Pyromatics ({1}{R}, 1 damage to any target) has replicate {1}{R}. Djinn Illuminatus gives it a second replicate instance whose cost equals its mana cost, {1}{R}. Centaur Courser is a 3/3.

decisions: A casts Pyromatics targeting Centaur Courser, paying its own replicate cost once and Djinn Illuminatus's replicate cost once, tapping all six Mountains.
Each replicate instance's trigger resolves; every copy keeps the target Centaur Courser. Both players pass until the stack is empty.

variants.label: both_paid_once
variants.expected: Two replicate triggers fire, each creating one copy. Pyromatics and its two copies deal 3 damage to Centaur Courser, which dies.

variants.label: granted_unpaid
variants.delta: Djinn Illuminatus's replicate cost is not paid; four Mountains are tapped.
variants.expected: Only the native replicate instance's trigger fires and creates one copy; the granted instance creates none. 2 damage total; Centaur Courser survives with 2 damage.

scenarios.forge_notes: Djinn Illuminatus grants Replicate:CardManaCost on the stack; check that Forge offers both instances' payments separately at casting.
